settings.editor: About Us
Green India Private Limited is one of the leading suppliers of compostable products in India.

We were founded to create a more sustainable, pollution-free society by promoting compostable and starch-based products instead of conventional petroleum-based plastic. We supply finished compostable bags and customise products for your needs.
All of our products are certified by the Central Pollution Control Board, New Delhi and CIPET, Chennai.
Replace petroleum plastic with compostable alternatives.
From Nature, Back to Nature.

settings.title: Features of the Green India Bioplastics

settings.editor: Green India Compostable Products are produced using various compostable polymers obtained from different types of renewable sources. All the products sold by Green India are certified Compostable.
